risk_unit_basis: 100000 capital x 5 exposure x (1.20% stop + 0.05% cost); held fixed in cost stress
daily_trigger: Latch after cumulative realised net P&L reaches -1R for half sizing, or -2R for halting new orders. Reset every session. Only exits strictly before confirmation count. Pending earlier orders keep their accepted size; existing positions retain native exits.
persistent_rule: Last two consecutive completed 5m Nifty candle bodies each oppose trade by at least 0.05%, and latest close opposes session open by at least 0.15%. Before two candles or if previous bar is unavailable, do not apply this extra filter; record that status.
combination_rule: Minimum of persistent half-size and daily 1R half-size; never quarter size
protocol: Small fixed catalogue, saved before new G6 outcomes. No threshold optimisation or per-setup tuning. All 54 sessions were previously inspected: chronological slices and bootstrap are diagnostics, not untouched validation. Do not promote from this run alone.
